parameter.name: pollInterval
parameter.label: Poll Interval
parameter.description: Time between polling the data in ms. Sigenergy devices support a minimum interval of 1000 ms.

parameter.name: maxTries
parameter.label: Maximum Tries When Reading
parameter.description: Specifies how many times the binding should retry reading data if a read attempt fails. Set to `1` to disable retries and use a single attempt.

parameter.name: unitId
parameter.label: Inverter Unit ID
parameter.description: The inverter's own Modbus unit ID (1-246), as configured in the mySigen app. Distinct from the plant unit ID 247 on the bridge.
